traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements from docs/stories/020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md are implemented and verified: - File-level @supports annotations in test files are enforced by ensureFileSupportsAnnotation; missing annotations produce a clear error (missingFileSupports) and an optional safe placeholder template auto-fix (REQ-TEST-FILE-SUPPORTS). - describe() blocks in test files are required to contain a story reference matching a configurable regex (defaulting to the specified "Story XXX.X-" pattern); violations emit missingDescribeStory (REQ-TEST-DESCRIBE-STORY). - it()/test() names must start with a [REQ-XXX] prefix; missing or malformed prefixes emit missingReqPrefix, with safe normalization auto-fixes for malformed but recognizable IDs (REQ-TEST-IT-REQ-PREFIX, REQ-TEST-ERROR-CONTEXT). - Test file detection matches the specified directories and extensions via simple configurable substrings (REQ-TEST-PATTERN-DETECT). - Framework and variant support is provided for describe, it, test, context, and member-call variants like describe.each/test.each (REQ-TEST-FRAMEWORK-COMPAT). - Nested describe blocks are handled uniformly via a CallExpression visitor (REQ-TEST-NESTED-DESCRIBE). - Validity of @supports content (story paths and requirement IDs) is handled by existing rules valid-story-reference and valid-req-reference, which are active for all files, satisfying REQ-TEST-SUPPORTS-VALID and the declared dependencies. - The rule follows ESLint best practices (meta, schema, options, messages, fixers), is integrated into the plugin’s dynamic rule loading and recommended/strict configs, has comprehensive rule tests, and is documented in user-docs/api-reference.md.
Given the concrete implementation, integration, tests, and documentation, this story is fully implemented and passes all specified acceptance criteria.
